candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student Product Documentation & BI Dashboard (All Genders)
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Product Documentation & BI Dashboards. Your two missions, migrating dashboards to a new platform and keeping documentation clear, are both things I have done in industry, which makes this role an unusually close match.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting, building dashboards, data models and SQL-based reporting for business teams.

achievements.impact: I joined a team migrating 42 dashboards from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere and independently rebuilt a full dashboard and its data pipelines
I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement
I documented data sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built, so colleagues could support them too

letter.problems_section: In your team I would help design and test the new dashboard views, validate them against the existing reports with SQL, and document the new setup for internal stakeholders. I enjoy writing clear documentation, and I am curious about self-hosted and AI-assisted BI tools, which I would learn quickly.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week. I would be glad to discuss how I can support both work streams.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
